definitions.explanation: The act of two or more things joining together into one. Used for physical combinations, organizational mergers, and in anime/manga for characters or robots merging.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{会社|かいしゃ}が{合体|がったい}した。
ロボットが{合体|がったい}して{巨大|きょだい}ロボになる。
examples.english: The robots combine to form a giant robot.

examples.japanese: {異|こと}なる{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{合体|がったい}させることで、これまでにない{新|あたら}しい{製品|せいひん}が{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: By combining different technologies, an entirely new product was created.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb: {合体|がったい}する (to combine/merge). Particularly well-known in anime and tokusatsu (special effects shows) culture, where characters or machines merge into a single, more powerful form. Also used in general contexts for mergers and combinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合体|がったい}する: to combine, to merge
- {合体|がったい}ロボ: combining robot
- {合体|がったい}{技|わざ}: combination technique/move

SIMILAR WORDS:
{合体|がったい} emphasizes physically joining into one body. {合併|がっぺい} is used for organizational mergers (companies, municipalities). {融合|ゆうごう} means blending or fusing, often for abstract concepts or cultural mixing. {統合|とうごう} means integration or consolidation of systems or organizations.
